rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Vorim AI provides an identity and trust infrastructure for AI agents through 13 MCP tools across five categories: health checks, agent identity management (register, retrieve, update, revoke), permission management (grant, check, list, revoke scopes with time and rate limits), audit trail generation (immutable signed logs), and trust scoring (behavioral assessment rated 0-100). Requires a Vorim AI API key.
